newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli troops kill one Palestinian, wound five.
newsitem.headline: Israeli troops kill one Palestinian, wound five.

text.p: Israeli soldiers on Wednesday shot dead one Palestinian and wounded five in two incidents in the West Bank, Israeli security sources and Palestinians said.
The security sources identified the dead man as Mu'taz Jaradat and said he died on his way from the Hebron area to an Israeli hospital from bullet wounds to the abdomen.

Soldiers shot and killed Jaradat and wounded four other people who were stoning Israeli cars at Siir near the West Bank town of Hebron. In a separate incident in the same area troops shot and wounded a Palestinian policeman by accident.
The Israeli army said it was checking the report.

Jaradat's death raised to 58 the number of Palestinians killed by Israelis since violence erupted last week after the Jewish state opened a second entrance to a controversial tunnel near Islamic holy shrines in Arab East Jerusalem. Palestinian police have killed 15 Israeli soldiers in gun battles.

President Bill Clinton is hosting a summit in Washington between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in an effort to end the violence and save the Middle East peace process.
